_comment: Shared parity fixture. Read by BOTH CinderpawAgent/tests/pii-redaction.test.ts (memory redaction, TypeScript) and crates/cinderpaw-core/tests/secret_redaction_parity.rs (transcript redaction, Rust). The two redactors are separate implementations in separate processes; a format one catches and the other misses is still a leaked secret, and only a shared fixture makes that drift fail a test. When you add a format, add it here first.
